name: BVG with a quarter as a lump sum, and 1% real interest
workings: Born 1963-03-01; retirement assets 500,000.00; conversion rate 5.4% at 65, 0.2 points less for each year earlier, more for each later; real interest 1%; Swiss inflation 1%.
At 63: assets 500,000.0000; rate 5%; annuity 25,000.0000; with 25% as a lump sum: 125,000.0000 and an annuity of 18,750.0000.
At 65: assets 510,050.0000; rate 5.4%; annuity 27,542.7000; with 25% as a lump sum: 127,512.5000 and an annuity of 20,657.0250.
The annuity is nominal: in today's francs it changes by 1/1.01 − 1 = -0.009901 a year.
With lumpSumShare 0.25 the partial route comes first, so it's the default; the plan's claimRoute can pick the annuity or the lump sum.
